text: Notice the dipole moment. Chlorobenzene, one point six nine debye, is less polar than chloromethane, one point eight six. Chlorine's lone pair partly flows back into the ring, opposing the pull of its electronegativity, and the s p two carbon holds its electrons more tightly. Both ideas matter in the next part.
